label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" when the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set, so password reset (and other) emails link to localhost in environments where that variable is missing or unset after the last release. Fix by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is always set in production config, or by making BASE_URL fail loudly instead of silently defaulting to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The BASE_URL constant falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and other links like the rollup and export URLs). In production, PUBLIC_URL appears to be unset or not propagated to this module, so users receive reset emails pointing at localhost instead of the real site.

Proposed fix: ensure the production environment properly sets PUBLIC_URL (e.g. via config/deployment env vars) and/or have BASE_URL read from a validated config value (such as config.app.publicUrl) rather than directly from process.env, throwing or logging a clear error at startup if it's missing in production. This avoids silently falling back to localhost in a live environment and ensures password reset links (and other email links) are correct.
